First, 34 weeks + 6 days = (34 × 7) + 6 = 238 + 6 = 244 days.  

Start date: 1335-06-24 (assuming format MM-DD-YYYY means June 24, 1335).  

1335 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1335 not divisible by 4).  

Days in June after 24th: 30 - 24 = 6 days used.  
Remaining days to add: 244 - 6 = 238 days left.  

July 1335: 31 days → 238 - 31 = 207 left.  
August: 31 → 207 - 31 = 176 left.  
September: 30 → 176 - 30 = 146 left.  
October: 31 → 146 - 31 = 115 left.  
November: 30 → 115 - 30 = 85 left.  
December: 31 → 85 - 31 = 54 left.  

Now into 1336 (leap year? 1336 divisible by 4 → yes, leap year).  

January 1336: 31 → 54 - 31 = 23 left.  
February 1336: 29 days (leap) → 23 - 29 = -6 means February 29 - 6 days back = February 23, 1336.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1336-02-23
